requirements.title: A conditional expression is a primary selecting a chosen subexpression
requirements.definition: A conditional expression is classified as a primary and selects a chosen subexpression. The detailed conditional evaluation rules, including which guards or expressions are evaluated, are dependencies rather than local fixture coverage.

pending.primary-classification: PENDING positive-control source shape using a conditional expression where R1001 requires a primary, then assigning the result to a scalar checked against a literal. The syntax of the conditional is credited to R1002.
pending.true-arm-selection: PENDING positive-control source shape with a literal .true. scalar-logical guard and arms producing distinct integer literals 11 and 22; the oracle is literal 11 and reached execution. Evaluation-order details remain 10.1.4 dependencies.
pending.false-arm-selection: PENDING positive-control source shape with a literal .false. scalar-logical guard and distinct literal arms; the oracle is the false-arm literal. The control proves both arms are type/rank compatible under C1004.
pending.nested-selection: PENDING positive-control source shape using the repeated ': guard ? expr' form with guard literals selecting the middle or final arm and distinct literal results. Non-vacuity requires at least two executions or two statements selecting different arms.

requirements.oracle: Future controls use distinct literal arm values and separately satisfy C1004. They must not claim short-circuit evaluation coverage beyond the rules later catalogued for 10.1.4.
requirements.oracle_limitation: This source-only catalogue records pending plans only. It creates no Fortran test program, invokes no processor, approves no fixture or oracle, and claims no coverage. Numbered syntax rules and constraints carry the 4.2 diagnostic-capability duty, but future negative plans must isolate the cited rule or constraint and must not rely on compiler agreement, address arithmetic, TRANSFER, emitted code, undefined reads, or interpretation and evaluation rules owned by 10.1.3-10.1.12.
requirements.dependencies: 10.1.2.2R1001;10.1.2.9R1023;10.1.4 conditional evaluation;10.1.5 logical operations;10.1.9 result characteristics;10.2.1.3.

requirements.title: A conditional expression has parenthesized guarded arms and a final fallback expression
requirements.definition: The conditional-expr syntax is an opening parenthesis, a scalar-logical-expr guard, question mark, an expr, zero or more ': scalar-logical-expr ? expr' repetitions, a colon, a final expr, and a closing parenthesis.

pending.two-arm-form: PENDING positive-control source shape '( .true. ? 3 : 4 )' assigned to an integer and checked against literal 3. The two arms have the same declared type, kind, and rank so C1004 is not implicated.
pending.chained-guard-form: PENDING positive-control source shape with one ': .true. ? 5' repetition and final literal 6, using guard literals so the oracle is literal 5. Distinct arm literals make the repetition non-vacuous.
pending.scalar-logical-guard: PENDING positive-control source shape whose guard is a scalar logical expression such as i==1 with i assigned literal 1, and whose selected arm has a literal oracle. The relation's interpretation is a dependency.
pending.missing-final-colon-rejected: PENDING diagnostic/control source shape omitting only the final ': expr' from an otherwise valid conditional expression. Repair inserts ': 4' and observes literal 3 or 4; same-type arms isolate R1002 rather than C1004.
pending.missing-question-rejected: PENDING diagnostic/control source shape omitting only the '?' after a scalar-logical guard while keeping all expressions type-compatible. Repair restores '?' and observes a literal arm value, attributing the violation to R1002 punctuation.

requirements.oracle: Syntax negatives must keep all expressions declared and C1004-compatible so the malformed conditional punctuation or shape is the only cited defect.
requirements.oracle_limitation: This source-only catalogue records pending plans only. It creates no Fortran test program, invokes no processor, approves no fixture or oracle, and claims no coverage. requirements.title: All conditional-expression result arms have the same declared type, kind parameters, and rank
requirements.definition: Each expr result arm of a conditional-expr shall have the same declared type, the same kind type parameters, and the same rank. The constraint applies to all selectable result expressions, not to the scalar logical guards.

pending.same-characteristics-control: PENDING positive-control source shape with all arms INTEGER of the same kind and scalar rank, selected by literal guards and checked against distinct integer literal results. This control satisfies C1004.
pending.declared-type-mismatch-rejected: PENDING diagnostic/control source shape with valid R1002 syntax and scalar logical guard but INTEGER and REAL result arms of the same rank. Repair changes only the REAL arm to an INTEGER literal with a distinct value; the violation is attributable to C1004 declared type mismatch.
pending.kind-parameter-mismatch-rejected: PENDING diagnostic/control source shape with two INTEGER arms of explicitly different kind parameters, valid syntax, and scalar guards. Repair changes only one kind selector to match and checks a literal value, isolating C1004 kind-parameter mismatch.
pending.rank-mismatch-rejected: PENDING diagnostic/control source shape with one scalar INTEGER arm and one rank-one INTEGER array arm of the same kind under valid R1002 syntax. Repair makes both arms scalar or both arrays and observes a literal, so rank mismatch is the only C1004 violation.
pending.nested-arm-characteristics: PENDING positive-control source shape with a chained conditional containing three result arms all same declared type, kind, and rank but distinct literal values. Guards select at least two arms across executions or statements, making the all-arms rule non-vacuous.

requirements.oracle: Negative plans must use syntactically valid conditionals with scalar logical guards so the reported defect is the arm characteristic mismatch, not malformed R1002 syntax or invalid logical expressions.
